title: Wild-bird dispersal of H5N1 2.3.4.4b — expansion, amplification, limits
caption: Wild birds move it, coasts amplify it, Oceania awaits it. Intercontinental introductions seeded a monophyletic Americas invasion; spread ran rapidly down Pacific-coastal flyways, with Chile the amplification hotspot (73.7% wild-bird positivity, 714 positives, >3,800 km of coastline in four months) hitting marine and colonial seabirds hardest. Oceania is the only major region still unaffected (as of March 2025) — yet predicted-susceptible. Host range expanded to >130 non-waterfowl species.
